source: Orange County Clerk of the Board, Board of Supervisors meeting agendas

items.text: Chair Chaffee - Orange County HIV Planning Council - Reappoint Dr. Sean Arayasirikul, Montebello, Martin Becerra, Costa Mesa, Jazmina Castillo, Aliso Viejo and Leroy Blea, Berkeley, for terms ending 12/31/28; and waive voter requirements in Article IV, Section 3 of bylaws for Dr. Sean Arayasirikul, Martin Becerra and Leroy Blea
Sheriff-Coroner - Adopt resolution rescinding Resolution No. 91-682 and authorizing closure of Flash Fund; and direct deposit of funds back to County General Fund - All Districts
Clerk of the Board - Approve proposed amendments to the Conflict of Interest Code Designated Filer Exhibits for North Orange County Regional Occupational Program - Districts 1, 2, 3 and 4
Clerk of the Board - Approve proposed amendments to the Conflict of Interest Code Designated Filer Exhibits for Orange County Classical Academy - District 3
Clerk of the Board - Approve proposed amendments to the Conflict of Interest Code Designated Filer Exhibits for Newport-Mesa Unified School District - District 5
Clerk of the Board - Approve proposed amendments to the Conflict of Interest Code Designated Filer Exhibits for Cypress School District - District 1
Clerk of the Board - Approve proposed amendments to the Conflict of Interest Code Designated Filer Exhibits for Garden Grove Unified School District - Districts 1 and 2
County Executive Office - Receive and file Annual Report of Minor Real Property Interests obtained under Delegated Authority, 7/1/25 - 6/30/26 - All Districts

County Executive Office - Adopt resolution approving FY 2025-26 Measure M2 Expenditure Report; and authorizing Chief Financial Officer or designee to execute and submit report to Orange County Transportation Authority - All Districts

County Executive Office - Accept donation from Angels Baseball LP to support Common Good Workforce Reentry Center ($50,000); and authorize Chief Real Estate Officer or designee to accept donation and execute related documents - District 2

County Executive Office - Approve Ninth Amended and Restated County of Orange Section 125 Plan Document, effective 1/1/27; and authorize Chief Human Resources Officer or designee to make changes under certain conditions and execute Plan Document - All Districts

County Executive Office - Accept Irrevocable Offer of Dedication from FN Projects Inc. for street and highway purposes for O'Neill Regional Park; adopt Resolution of Acceptance for access to O'Neill Regional Park; authorize Chief Real Estate Officer or designee to execute related documents under certain conditions; and making California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) exemption findings, Class 25, under CEQA Guidelines Section 15325(f) - District 3
OC Public Works - Receive and file FY 2025-26 Development Fee Deposit Balance Reports; and make findings under Government Code Section 66001(d)(1) - All Districts

OC Public Works - Acting as Orange County Flood Control District - Adopt resolutions adopting 2026 Orange County Floodplain Management Plan, 2026 Orange County Program for Public Information, and 2026 Orange County Repetitive Loss Area Analysis; authorize Director or designee to approve updated Orange County Repetitive Loss Area Analysis; and make California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) exemption findings under CEQA Guidelines Section 15061(b)(3) - All Districts (Continued from 11/17/26, Item 3)

Registrar of Voters - Receive and file certification of election results and Statement of Votes Cast for November 3, 2026 General Election; and declare elected the persons having majority of votes for that office - All Districts
Registrar of Voters - Appoint in lieu of election on 11/3/26 qualified candidates listed in Certificate of Facts and Nominees to special district offices - Districts 1 and 3
Social Services Agency - Receive and file 32nd Annual Report on Conditions of Children in Orange County 2026 - All Districts

Clerk-Recorder - Consider second reading and adoption of "An Ordinance of the County of Orange, California, Repealing Uncodified Ordinance No. 00-3 and Adopting a New Fee Ordinance Regarding Marriage License and Ceremony Fees; Services Related to Fictitious Business Names; and Various County Clerk Fees"; adopt resolution rescinding Resolution 95-143 in its entirety and Resolution 24-084, in part establishing various County Clerk fees, effective 1/1/27; and making California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) exemption findings under CEQA Guidelines Sections 15273(a)(1) and (a)(2) and other related findings - All Districts (Continued from 11/17/26, Item 32)

Sheriff-Coroner - Approve amendment 3 to contract MA-060-22010842 with Omni Enterprise Inc. for janitorial services, 1/25/27 - 1/24/28 ($317,880; cumulative $1,907,280); and authorize County Procurement Officer or Deputized designee to execute amendment - District 2

Sheriff-Coroner - Approve amendment 6 to contract MA-060-21010012 with Idemia Identity & Security USA LLC for maintenance of Automated Biometric Identification System, 1/27/27 - 1/26/28 ($292,420; cumulative total $1,851,607); and authorize County Procurement Officer or Deputized designee to execute amendment - District 2

Sheriff-Coroner - Approve amendment 5 to subordinate contract MA-060-24010480 with Majestic Fire Inc. dba Kord Fire Protection for fire extinguisher and hose maintenance services, term ending 11/14/28 ($180,000; cumulative $1,135,509); and authorize County Procurement Officer or Deputized designee to execute amendment; and make California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) exemption findings under CEQA Guidelines Section 15301 - All Districts

Sheriff-Coroner - Approve retroactive amendment 5 to contract MA-060-21011079 with Pepperdine University for youth diversion counseling services, 7/1/25 - 6/30/26 ($5,500; cumulative total $2,510,236); and authorize County Procurement Officer or Deputized designee to execute amendment - All Districts

Sheriff-Coroner - Approve amendment 1 to contract MA-060-24010043 with Seavco Inc. dba Irv Seaver Motorcycles for maintenance services, 3/12/27 - 3/11/28 ($291,666; cumulative $1,166,666); renewable for one additional one-year term; and authorize County Procurement Officer or Deputized designee to execute amendment - District 2

County Executive Office - Approve model contract for rapid rehousing services for individuals and families ($3,746,998), and transitional aged youth ($2,012,206), 1/1/27 - 12/31/28; renewable for three additional one-year terms; select respondents from solicitation results; and authorize County Procurement Officer or Deputized designee to exercise cost contingency increase not to exceed 10% under certain conditions and negotiate and execute contracts under certain conditions - All Districts

County Executive Office - Approve grant applications/awards submitted by District Attorney and Health Care Agency, retroactive grant application/award submitted by OC Community Resources and ratified grant application/award submitted by OC Community Resources in 12/1/26 grant report and other actions as recommended; and adopt resolution authorizing District Attorney or designee to execute grant award agreement and amendments under certain conditions with California Department of Insurance for Automobile Insurance Fraud Program, 7/1/26 - 6/30/27 ($1,575,094) - All Districts
County Executive Office - Approve 2027 Community Project Funding Requests and receive and file Legislative Bulletin - All Districts

County Executive Office - Approve amendments to contracts with various providers for Juvenile Justice Crime Prevention Act Funding Opportunity Program, 1/1/27 - 6/30/27; and authorize County Procurement Officer or Deputized designee to execute amendments - All Districts

Health Care Agency - Approve contract MA-042-26010438 with Carelon Behavioral Health of California, Inc. for administrative services organization of specialty mental health and drug Medi- Cal substance use disorder services, 1/1/27 - 6/30/29 ($40,098,527); renewable for one additional two-year term; and authorize County Procurement Officer or Deputized designee to exercise cost contingency increase not to exceed 10% under certain conditions and execute contract - All Districts

Health Care Agency - Approve amendments to contracts with various providers of youth substance use prevention services, 7/1/27 - 6/30/29 ($1,400,000 each; cumulative total $3,500,000 each); and authorize County Procurement Officer or Deputized designee to execute amendments - All Districts

Health Care Agency - Approve Orange County Behavioral Health Integrated Plan Intermittent Update for Behavioral Health Services Act programs and services; and authorize Director or designee to execute and submit update to California Department of Health Care Services - All Districts

Health Care Agency - Approve amendment 10 to extend contract MA-042-21011159 with Orange County Asian and Pacific Islander Community Alliance, Inc. for children and transitional age youth full service partnership/wraparound services, 1/1/27 - 6/30/27 ($2,052,872; cumulative total $22,734,664); and authorize County Procurement Officer or Deputized designee to execute amendment - All Districts

Health Care Agency - Approve amendment 18 to contract with Orange County Health Authority dba CalOptima Health for coordination and provision of public health care services, effective 12/1/26; renew contract 1/1/27 - 12/31/31; and authorize Director or designee to execute amendment - All Districts

OC Community Resources - Approve amendment 1 to renew contract MA-012-26010229 with Goodwill Industries of Orange County, California for workforce readiness services for adults with disabilities under Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act, 1/1/27 - 12/31/27 ($309,324; cumulative total $721,756); and authorize County Procurement Officer or Deputized designee to execute amendment - All Districts

OC Community Resources - Approve addendum 3 to Affordable Housing Implementation agreement with various owners of real property in Ranch Plan Development for Rancho Mission Viejo Development; authorize Director or designee to execute addendum and related documents under certain conditions; authorize Chief Real Estate Officer or designee to execute Certificates of Acceptance for Irrevocable Offers of Dedication and take all necessary actions, and execute any additional documents under certain conditions; and authorize OC Public Works Director or designee to execute Blended Apartment agreements to facilitate implementation of the "Units Plan" - District 5

OC Public Works - Approve Final Initial Study/Mitigated Negative Declaration No. PP-24-0054; authorize Director or designee to finalize Implementation Guidelines for Orange County Sand Compatibility and Opportunistic Use Program, and make minor changes under certain conditions; and make California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) exemption findings under CEQA Guidelines Section 15074(d) and Public Resources Code Section 21081.6 and other related findings - All Districts

OC Public Works - Adopt resolution implementing electric vehicle charging rates, FY 2026-27 and FY 2027-28; making related findings; and make California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) exemption findings under CEQA Guidelines Section 15273 and Public Resources Code Section 21080(b)(8) - All Districts

OC Public Works - Approve model contracts for progressive design-build services, 1,300-day term ($50,000,000) and construction management services ($1,300,000) for New Emergency Operations Center Project; select respondent and approve alternate respondents from solicitation results; authorize Director or designee to negotiate and execute contracts and future amendments under certain conditions; and make California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) exemption findings under CEQA Guidelines Sections 15301, 15302, and 15332 - District 2

OC Community Resources - Public Hearing to consider adopting FY 2027-28 Funding Allocation Policy and Process for Housing and Community Development activities; approve substantial amendment to FY 2026-27 Annual Action Plan to reprogram $79,660 as requested by City of Yorba Linda from their Multi-Family Housing Rehabilitation- Evergreen Villas Roof Rehabilitation Project to their Public Facility & Improvement Project- Citywide Sidewalk and ADA Improvements; approve amendment 2 to contract MA-012-26011069 with City of Yorba Linda for reprogramming of Public Facility & Improvement, 7/1/26 - 6/30/27 ($79,660; cumulative total $301,000); and authorize County Procurement Officer or Deputized designee to execute amendment - All Districts

OC Community Resources - Public Hearing to consider adopting resolution approving revised OC Parks fee schedule updating alcoholic beverage service; superseding Resolution Nos. 91-770B and 98-432 and rescinding Resolution Nos. 13-084 and 22-148; adopt resolution limiting overnight stays at camping facilities to maximum of 30 nights in calendar year; and making California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) exemption findings under Public Resources Code Section 21080(b)(8) and CEQA Guidelines Sections 15273 and 15301 and other findings - All Districts (Continued from 11/17/26, Item 34)

County Executive Office - CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATOR - Pursuant to Government Code Section 54957.6: Agency Negotiator: Jamie Newton, Chief Human Resources Officer Employee Organizations: Association of Orange County Deputy Sheriffs (AOCDS), Association of County Law Enforcement Managers (ACLEM), American Federation of State, County and Municipal Employees (AFSCME), Teamsters, and other non-represented employees RE: Terms and Conditions of Employment

County Counsel - CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL - EXISTING LITIGATION - Pursuant to Government Code Section 54956.9(d)(1): Name of Case: Ralph Rocha v. County of Orange, Orange County Superior Court Case No. 30- 2024-01410423-CU-OE-WJC
